question: Will Arbitrum exceed $0.1813 on CoinGecko at 23:45 UTC on 8 Oct 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the CoinGecko USD price for Arbitrum (ARB) at 2026-10-08T23:45:00.000Z is strictly greater than $0.1813.
- "No": Wins if that same price is $0.1813 or below.

Clarifications:
- The governing figure is CoinGecko's USD price for id "arbitrum" at that instant — the last published value at or before 2026-10-08T23:45:00.000Z if there is no tick exactly then (for example, an hourly 23:00 UTC value if only hourly granularity is available).
- CoinGecko is the measure. An exchange-specific pair such as Binance ARB/USDT can fall on the opposite side of the threshold.
